business_problem: Traditional forecasting required work across multiple software platforms and datasets, making it time-consuming. ADNOC needed to improve reservoir management and field-development planning, including decisions about new wells, existing-well performance, and injection and production volumes.
solution_summary: ADNOC deployed AIQ's Advanced Reservoir 360 (AR360), developed by AIQ with SLB under ADNOC's ENERGYai strategy, first on two reservoirs at Bab and Umm Shaif in early 2024 and then across more than 30 reservoirs in upstream operations. The source says AR360 applies artificial intelligence and machine learning to reservoir management and field-development planning, consolidating forecasting work previously spread across multiple software platforms and datasets onto a single platform. It supports decisions about drilling new wells, improving existing-well performance, and optimizing injection and production volumes, with the stated aims of reducing planning time and increasing well life and recovery rates. The article does not describe data-ingestion mechanisms, processing services, storage, interfaces, or specific downstream integrations.

evidence_quotes: AR360 uses artificial intelligence (AI) and machine learning technologies to improve reservoir management and optimize field development planning.

While traditional forecasting technologies require working across multiple software platforms and data sets, which can be time-consuming, AR360 integrates everything on a single platform and utilizes AI to save time and enable better and more proactive decision-making.
AR360 reduces planning time while increasing well life and recovery rates.
Solution to be deployed on more than 30 ADNOC reservoirs, following successful initial deployment.
